subject: 元北方路府官署（原创扩展）
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make this compound clearly northern YUAN dynasty: remove ALL trees, grass and flower shrubs; lower and broaden all roof slopes; replace front and side enclosing walls with thick plain buff rammed earth plaster over sparse gray brick feet; simplify finials to plain rounded ridge tiles; retain dark gray tiles and realistic material texture. Keep a bare gray stone court, timber doors, yamen drum, sober central hall. Correct ground footprint: rectangle16x12, LEFT(120,510), FRONT(760,830), RIGHT(1240,590), hidden BACK(600,270) in a1448x1086 canvas. Both base axes MUST be exactly +/-0.5, not perspective, all corresponding wall/roof axes parallel. Low flat apron ONLY, entire model contained with transparent margins. Camera yaw45 pitch30 orthographic2:1. True transparent RGBA background, main light upper left, short contact shadow lower right. No words, flags, people, Qing ornaments, yellow glazed tiles, luxuriant garden, thick slab, background or grid.
negative: 文字、伪字、人物、现代物、天空、地平线、棋盘格、背景建筑、大阴影、厚地台、清式宫廷装饰、透视消失点、裁切。
